Hi! I'm Cassidy. I'm opening Open Stand in Bend, Oregon this fall and we'd love a website ready for the soft launch in October.

So — Open Stand is hard to describe in one sentence and we know it's a problem. It's a boutique fitness studio... but also kind of a wellness space? We're going to teach barre and pilates classes (that's the fitness side) but we're also going to have IV vitamin drips on offer two days a week, a small infrared sauna, and a low-key cafe in the front with adaptogenic drinks and bone broth. The space is 2,800 sq ft. The front cafe is publicly accessible without a class booking. The treatment rooms are appointment-only.

I keep going back and forth on whether we're a "fitness studio with wellness add-ons" or a "wellness space with classes." Honestly neither feels right. We're trying to be a third-place for women in their 30s–40s in Bend who care about how they feel but are kind of done with the SoulCycle-adjacent boutique cardio scene that's everywhere right now. We want it to feel like the bathroom at the Erewhon Calabasas but in a smaller and weirder Pacific Northwest way.

Vibe is: minimal, warm, slightly ceramic-studio-feeling. Lots of natural wood. The branding so far is in a soft sage green with a charcoal text color. We don't want the trendy bouclé-and-arches look that's everywhere — that ship has sailed.

Pricing — premium. Classes are $32 drop-in or $250/month unlimited. IV drips are $135–275. Cafe items are normal coffee shop prices.

The website needs: a landing page, a class schedule (we'll handle bookings through Mariana Tek so just the link works), a services page for the IV/sauna stuff, an about page, contact.

I forgot to say — Cassidy Lieu, that's me. I'm a former physical therapist (15 years). My business partner is Dr. Anika Olsen, MD, an internist who's running the IV side.

email is cassidy@openstand.studio. We don't have a phone number set up yet, just text me at 541-555-0290 for now I guess.
